source.title: Staged docs for Award Funding Rollup

observations.statement: Documentation defines the route as POST /api/v2/awards/funding_rollup/ and describes it as returning total transaction obligations plus counts of awarding agencies, funding agencies, and federal accounts for an award.
The docs mark award_id as the required request attribute and also show page, sort, order, and limit in the sample request body even though they are not described as formal attributes.
The documented 200 response body is a single aggregate JSON object with total_transaction_obligated_amount, awarding_agency_count, funding_agency_count, and federal_account_count.
The retired low-level artifact exposes only award_id in its input schema and does not expose page, sort, order, or limit as MCP request fields.
The retired low-level artifact records prior live behavior that unknown award identifiers return HTTP 200 with zero totals instead of an error and that additional body keys are ignored.

The retired low-level artifact also records prior live behavior that award_id accepts strings or integers, trims surrounding whitespace for strings, rejects floats, booleans, null, arrays, and objects with HTTP 422, and can return negative total_transaction_obligated_amount values for some awards.

source.title: Award funding rollup view and validator

observations.statement: Source code decorates the view with validate_post_request([get_internal_or_generated_award_id_model()]), so the endpoint validates only award_id and accepts either an integer internal award id or a text generated award id.
The view's business logic reads request_data['award_id'] and ignores other body keys; if award_id is an integer it queries the award_id column, otherwise it queries generated_unique_award_id.

The SQL sums transaction_obligated_amount from financial_accounts_by_awards rows that are attached to submission windows whose reveal date has passed, counts distinct awarding and funding top-tier agencies, and counts distinct federal accounts by agency_id-main_account_code combinations from treasury appropriation accounts.

source.title: Derived MCP request coverage check for funding rollup

observations.statement: Relative to the staged docs, the retired low-level artifact omits four documented request-body fields from the MCP surface: page, sort, order, and limit.

Those omitted fields are still worth preserving semantically because they appear in the docs and help explain the doc/API contradiction, even though source and prior profile evidence indicate the live service ignores them.

source.title: Live baseline probe for award funding rollup

observations.statement: A live POST with a generated award id returned HTTP 200 JSON on 2026-05-12, confirming the endpoint is currently callable.

The live response matched the documented single-object aggregate shape and returned total_transaction_obligated_amount 2729344672.23 with awarding_agency_count 1, funding_agency_count 1, and federal_account_count 17.

source.title: Reviewer-backed funding-rollup dashboard reconciliation for HT940216C0001

observations.statement: In the reviewer-backed dashboard drilldown, v2__search__spending_by_award returned HT940216C0001 for HUMANA GOVERNMENT BUSINESS INC with Award Amount 51269205263.03 and generated_internal_id CONT_AWD_HT940216C0001_9700_-NONE-_-NONE-.

For that same generated award id, v2__awards__award_id returned total_obligation 51269205263.03 and total_account_obligation 321840, while v2__awards__funding_rollup returned total_transaction_obligated_amount 321840.

The reviewer-backed follow-up call to v2__awards__funding returned one funding row with transaction_obligated_amount 321840 and page_metadata.hasNext false, showing that the rollup behaved like compact revealed funding/accounting evidence and aligned with award-detail total_account_obligation rather than headline total_obligation.

source.title: Reviewer report for funding-rollup multi-path reconciliation guidance

observations.statement: The reviewer-backed DEAC3243AL00036 drilldown reported award detail total_account_obligation 331046047 and total_account_outlay/total_outlay 576372104.83, while v2__awards__funding_rollup returned total_transaction_obligated_amount 576368263 for the same award.
That same funding-rollup response for DEAC3243AL00036 reported awarding_agency_count 1, funding_agency_count 1, and federal_account_count 2.

Together with the earlier HT940216C0001 reviewer evidence, the available story evidence now shows at least two reconciliation patterns: one award where funding_rollup aligned with total_account_obligation and another where it aligned much more closely with outlay-style measures than with total_account_obligation.
